# E125 -- Tupperware

## Metadata
- **Brand**: Tupperware
- **Industry**: Consumer Products / Food Storage / Kitchenware
- **Document**: Visual Identity Guidelines
- **Year**: 2024 (January 12, 2024)
- **Pages**: 77
- **Designer/Agency**: Not credited (internal brand management; contact Manuel Sandoval)

## Brand Strategy
- **Goal**: "Transform Tupperware to become a more consumer forward brand that inspires another 77 years of love for current and future generations."
- **Brand idea**: "Useful is Beautiful"
- **Purpose**: "Design innovative, ingenious products that work beautifully to enrich your life in and out of the kitchen."
- **Strategy shift**: From heritage/products-focused transactional brand to modern, emotional, consumer-centric brand.
- **Messaging pillars** (4): Ingenious Design Flawless Function; Buy Once Love for Life; Ready for Anything; Nurturing a Sustainable Future.
- **Beliefs**: Product love grows with use; kitchen should spark trust, confidence, joy; good design preserves the planet; say yes to reusable.
- **Tagline**: "Amazing Possibilities"

## Logo
- **Wordmark**: Custom "Tupperware" logotype with distinctive features -- open lid "T", T+u connection, shorter p descender, condensed T, Tupperware bowl silhouette shape, subtler e finial.
- **Big T Icon**: Standalone letter T with lid motif; used as favicon, social media profile, app icon, merchandise. Never mixed with full wordmark.
- **Original Badge**: Heritage device (container shape + sunburst lid, "Since 1946") used as supporting element alongside wordmark -- never locked up together, never used alone.
- **Tagline integration**: Wordmark + Tagline and Big T + Tagline lockups with specific spacing rules (Earl Sans Regular for tagline text).
- **Clear space**: 3X on all sides (X = height of T horizontal bar).
- **Minimum size**: 0.5" / 13mm for print, 150px for digital.
- **Registered trademark**: Detailed sizing rules for R symbol (1X height, minimum 1.2mm).
- **Colorways**: Can appear in any approved colour variation from the palette; black/white for print limitations.
- Misuse: no outlines, shadows/effects, rotation, holding shapes, altered composition, distortion, images over mark, multiple colours.

## Typography
- **Primary typeface**: Earl Sans -- custom sans serif developed for Tupperware. Five weights: Thin, Light, Regular, Bold, Black.
- **Fallback**: Monotype Grotesque (Adobe Suitcase) when Earl Sans cannot be installed.
- **Tracking**: 80 units for captions, -20 for titles, 0 for body copy.
- **Leading**: 20pt at 16pt body (captions), 40pt at 40pt (titles), 24pt at 21pt (body copy). Tighter tracking for larger type.
- **Hierarchy**: Headlines in Earl Sans Bold/Regular, titles in Earl Sans Regular, body in Earl Sans Light, captions in Earl Sans Bold.
- **Grid system**: 12-column grid for A4/presentation; 4-column for Instagram. Margins: 7mm print, 35-70px digital. Gutters: 5.5mm print, 35-70px digital.
- **Font treatment**: Animated typography in post-production (kinetic type, transitions, fades) to convey product functionality.

## Color
- Extensive 27-colour palette in three tiers:
  - **Core** (9 colours): Tupperware Blue (#7BD6DC / PMS 318C -- dominant brand colour), Fresh Green (#00C45B / PMS 7480C), Ocean Breeze (#476BFF / PMS 2727C), Sunshine Yellow (#F2C200 / PMS 7409), Citrus Orange (#FF7500 / PMS 1585), Radiant Red (#F03D0E / PMS 3556), Simple Gray (#939598 / Cool Gray 7C), Vibrant Pink (#FF578B / PMS 1915), Berry Bliss Purple (#BA5AED / PMS 265).
  - **Tints** (9 lighter variants): pastel versions of each core colour plus white.
  - **Shades** (9 darker variants): deep versions of each core colour plus near-black (#292929).
- **Tupperware Blue** is the dominant packaging colour with dedicated blue variation pairings.
- Detailed suggested pairings and pairings to avoid; ADA compliance required for text-on-colour combinations.
- Pairing rules: shade text on core/tint backgrounds OK; core text on shade backgrounds OK; tint+core text on each other NOT allowed.
- Full hex, CMYK, RGB, and Pantone values for all 27 colours.

## Graphics
- **Container silhouette**: Iconic Tupperware container shape (blend of circle and square, 47.5/42.5 degree rounded corners) used as a framing/storytelling device.
  - Adaptable to landscape/portrait; used to hold imagery, text, Big T, infographics, page numbers, CTAs.
  - Must maintain consistent ratio; no busy patterns, no outlines, no mixed core colours in same layout.
- **Bars and digital backgrounds**: Plain colour only, same colour scheme as asset; no patterns or drawings.
- **Seasonal icons/illustrations**: Minimal use, same colour scheme as asset, contextual to season (snowflakes for winter, hearts for Valentine's).

## Photography
- **Philosophy**: "Our products look good on a shelf. But they're truly beautiful in action."
- **Style**: Minimalist, modern, colourful, joyful. Clean backgrounds, ample lighting, simple compositions, product in use.
- **Categories**:
  - Product Closeup + Hand: macro shots showing product in use with hands for scale. Soft diffused lighting, rule of thirds, negative space.
  - Product Closeup + Ingredient: real-world context with food. Balanced lighting, shallow depth of field.
  - Product + People: practical functionality plus emotional joy/ease. Balanced/soft key lighting, medium shot.
  - Product + Text: typography integrated with product photography for playful storytelling.
  - E-Commerce & Catalog: white background; single product shot or multicolour family groupings.
  - Multi-colored & Monochrome Products: tint backgrounds from Color Library for contrast.
  - Products with prints: background matched to predominant product colour from library.
  - Product families: background matched to dominant/largest product colour; equal distribution defaults to Tupperware Blue.
  - Colourless products (black/white/transparent): grayscale or Tupperware Blue background.

## Applications
- Catalogue spreads, landing pages, packaging sleeves, newsletters, social media (Instagram), presentation documents, in-store visuals, e-commerce listings.
- Grid specifications provided for A4, Instagram, and presentation formats.
- Bynder DAM referenced for brand resource downloads.

## Tone of Voice
- **Voice attributes**: Welcoming, Purposeful, Ingenious.
  - Welcoming: warm, playful, modern language, enthusiastic but not over-eager (save exclamation points).
  - Purposeful: clear main takeaways, cut fluff, but still approachable.
  - Ingenious: reveal unexpected insights, new perspectives, never know-it-all.
- Full Voice & Messaging Guidelines referenced as a separate document.

## Motion Principles
- **Wordmark in motion**: Big T lid opens to reveal remaining letters, as if contained within.
- **Big T in motion**: Animated lid opening reveals colour stories conveying adaptability, durability, joy.
- Both used as introduction bumper or encore for institutional videos.

## Outliers
- Remarkably comprehensive 2024 rebrand at 77 pages covering verbal identity, visual identity, photography, and motion.
- Container silhouette as a graphic framing device is a strong ownable element.
- 27-colour palette with three tiers (core/tint/shade) and detailed ADA-compliant pairing matrices is unusually thorough.
- Custom typeface (Earl Sans) developed specifically for the brand.
- Multiple "NEW" tags throughout TOC indicate this is a recent/active rebrand document.
- Legal trademark guidelines referenced but link placeholder left blank ("insert link") -- document appears slightly unfinished.
- Brand was facing bankruptcy context (filed September 2023); this January 2024 rebrand represents a transformation effort.

## Quality Score
4.5 / 5
Exceptionally comprehensive brand guidelines covering strategy, verbal identity, logo system (with heritage badge), extensive colour system with ADA compliance, custom typography with grid specs, detailed photography direction across 8+ categories, graphic devices (container silhouette), and motion principles. Minor deductions for incomplete legal links and occasional placeholder text ("FPO"). One of the strongest documents in the set for breadth and production value.
